premise: Tum {{playerName}} ho — Ashvale gaon ke Doran aur Elena ka beta, ISI duniya mein paida hua, isi mitti ka. Tumhare teen bachpan ki dost hain — Lyra, Seris, Valeria — jinhone tumhare saath purane oak ke neeche shaadi ka wada kiya tha. Jab chaaron 18 ke hue, ek hi raat ek hi sapna aaya: Radiant Goddess Seren ne chaaron ko chuna — Prince Aldric, the destined Hero, ke saath Demon King ke khilaaf jaana tha. Capital Velmora mein powers mile: teen ladkiyon ko chamakta talent, aur tumhe do bhairav-se-lagne waali upahar — chhoti si fire magic, aur ek dimensional storage jiski koi limit nahi. Phir safar shuru hua, aur safar ke dauraan sab kuch badla: dost badal gaye, wada bhool gaye, aur tum hero party ki 'walking pocket' ban gaye. Uske baad ek ke baad ek — rejection, jashn mein dhokha, jhoothi ilzamaat, qaid, arena... aur wo aakhri raat jab mask utre aur tumne apne hi haathon se haraye hue maa-baap ko pehchaana. Sab kuch planned tha. Ab tumhare paas sirf do cheezein hain: ek chhoti si aag, aur ek raaz — asli Demon Queen Lilith tumhare dimension mein chhupi hai. MY ABSOLUTE REVENGE ab shuru hota hai — aur iska har kadam tum khud likhoge.

locations.name: Ashvale
locations.description: Greenreach ki pahadiyon mein chhupa kisaan gaon — {{playerName}} ki janm-bhoomi. Purana oak, garam khet, aur wo aangan jahan chaar bachche ek saath bade hue the. Ab sirf raakh aur adhoori yaadein.

locations.name: Greenreach Hills
locations.description: Ashvale ko gale laga pahadiyan — shepherd trails, jhaadiyon mein chhupe springs, aur bachpan ke saare hideouts.

locations.name: Velmora — Eldrane ka Capital
locations.description: Sunehri spires, bade bazaars, aur itni kam taxes ki traders hanste-hanaste phod dete hain. Log kehte hain ye Seren ki kripa hai. Kripa... ya accounting? Yeh raaz abhi kholne ka nahi.

locations.name: The Crucible
locations.description: Velmora ka royal arena — din bhar bheed, raat ko khaali sankad. Yahan {{playerName}} ne teen mahine 'Pocket' ke naam se izzat kamayi... aur sab kuch gawa diya.

locations.name: Sunspire Palace
locations.description: Velmora ka dil — Raja ka darbar, Prince ka stage, aur wo bada balcony jahan jashn ki raat poori kahani palat gayi thi.

locations.name: Temple of First Light
locations.description: Seren ka mukhya mandir — safed paththar, pehli kiran ka pravesh, aur wo jagah jahan hero party ko aashirwad mila tha.

locations.name: Malgareth
locations.description: Blighted Wastes mein obsidian ka bada fortress — 'Demon King' Vorgath ka ghar. Sabki nazar mein yahan evil ka ilaqa tha... asli mein yahan takht ki asli waaris ka purana ghar hai.

locations.name: The Blighted Wastes
locations.description: Malgareth ke aas-paas ka kaala ilaaka — rakta-sa aasmaan, chup pahadiyan, aur wo sannata jo sunaai bhi deta hai.

locations.name: The Veiled Quarter
locations.description: Velmora ka andar ka chehra — smugglers, information-brokers, aur wo log jo jaante hain ki chamakti capital ka asli engine kahan chal raha hai.

locations.name: Ironmark
locations.description: Border par basa azad sheher — mercenary companies, underground arena circuit, aur loha wahan sabse pehle bolta hai.

locations.name: The Nightwilds
locations.description: Demon territories ka gehra hissa — jahan raat kabhi poori nahi hoti, aur Lilith ka khoya hua court ab bhi kisi-kisi ki yaad mein hai.

factions.name: The Eldrane Throne
factions.description: Raja ka darbar — jahan ab har faisla agle Raja, yani Aldric, ke raaste se aata hai.

factions.name: The Hero Party
factions.description: Kabhi PAANCH log the. Officially ab dissolved; unofficially teen log ek stage par khade hain... aur ek pocket mein ek raaz chhupi hai.

factions.name: Temple of First Light
factions.description: Seren ka clergy — aashirwad, propaganda, aur records. Unke archives mein har cheez ka ek version hota hai.

factions.name: The True Court
factions.description: Lilith ke purane log — chhipe hue, bikhre hue, intezaar mein. Unhe takht girte dekha... ab waqt ka intezaar hai.

factions.name: The Crucible Masters
factions.description: Arena ke asli maalik — prisoners, bets, aur 'entertainment' ki poori economics.

factions.name: Ironmark Free Companies
factions.description: Bechne ko kuch bhi, kisi ko bhi — bas rate sahi hona chahiye.

lore: Eldrane mein taxes lagbhag zero hain — log mante hain ye Seren ki kripa hai. Asli wajah abhi kholne ki nahi; clues dheere-dheere, story ke flow se khulenge.
Devi Seren ne Prince Aldric ko 'Dawnbreak' diya — roshni ka wo dhamaka jo pahad jaisa nishaana bhi mita deta hai. Usi devi ne chaaron bachchon ko wahi sapna diya tha.
'Demon King' Vorgath asli ruler kabhi tha hi nahi — takht ki asli waaris Lilith hai. Ye raaz ab sirf {{playerName}} ke paas hai.
Dimensional storage duniya mein bahut rare hai — log ise ek 'utility magic' samajhte hain. Isiliye kisi ne kabhi iski asli gehrai naapi hi nahi.

Duniya Eldrane se bahut badi hai — aur kingdoms, beast-races, free cities, purani civilizations... narration unhe naturally introduce kar sakta hai jab kahani aage badhe. Naye log, naye dushman, naye rishte — sab allowed.
rules: {{playerName}} is duniya mein PAIDA hua hai — Ashvale mein, isi mitti ka. Woh kisi doosri duniya se aaya nahi: koi portal nahi, koi reincarnation nahi, koi Earth origin nahi. Uski origin kabhi mat badalna.

{{playerName}} ke paas do abilities hain: (1) chhoti/basic fire magic — shuruaat mein yeh koi overwhelming power nahi hai; (2) dimensional storage — iski koi total capacity limit NAHI hai, bas ek rule: jo cheez {{playerName}} apni physical taqat se khud utha sake, wahi andar jaati hai. Retrieve woh baad mein kabhi bhi kar sakta hai.

Lilith ASLI Demon Queen hai — Vorgath ek decoy tha. Ye raaz sirf {{playerName}} ko pata hai. Lilith ab uske dimensional space ke andar chhupi hai; jab {{playerName}} apne dimension par focus karta hai, woh usse andar se baat kar sakti hai.
Lilith ka rishta {{playerName}} ke saath alliance se shuru hota hai — attraction ya pyaar INSTANT kabhi nahi. Uska trust sirf earned history se, dheere-dheere badhta hai.

Teen childhood friends — Lyra, Seris, Valeria — Aldric ke plan mein shaamil the. Ye daga canon hai; ise kabhi retcon ya soften mat karna. Par teeno ki reactions alag-alag hain aur waqt ke saath alag-alag tareeqe se evolve hoti hain.

Aldric ki taqat (Dawnbreak) abhi {{playerName}} ki combat ability se kai guna zyada hai — direct confrontation abhi haar ya maut hai. {{playerName}} ki growth dheere-dheere, training aur events se hoti hai — kabhi instant power-up se nahi.
{{playerName}} ki personality player ke haath mein hai — usse kabhi ruthless, compassionate ya merciful force mat karna. Uske emotions ko describe karo, decide mat karo.
Revenge journey ka pace player set karta hai — story kabhi aage nahi bhaagti aur use kabhi rok-tok nahi karti.
Sab kirdaar adults hain. Intense themes — betrayal, qaid, badla — allowed hain, par gore graphic detail mein kabhi nahi.

Har kirdar ka {{playerName}} ke saath apna alag, independent rishta hai — ek kirdar par asar doosre ko overwrite nahi karta. Lyra ka daga, Seris ka jhooth, Valeria ka chup rehna, Lilith ka alliance, Aldric ki nafrat — sab apne alag tracks par chalte hain.

importantObjects.name: Elena ka chandi ka locket
importantObjects.description: Arena ki ret se uthaya gaya maa ka locket — iske andar ek chhoti tasveer hai aur ek folding jo abhi poori nahi khuli.

importantObjects.name: Wo chhaas mask
importantObjects.description: Wo mask jo us aakhri ladai ke chhe qaidiyon ne pehne the. Ab {{playerName}} ki yaaddasht ka hissa — dard ka nishaan.

importantObjects.name: Seris ke purane fire-notes
importantObjects.description: Bachpan ki ek kitaab ka panna jis par Seris ne {{playerName}} ke liye fire magic ke notes banaye the — uske saath rakha hua, dard bhi, yaad bhi.

importantObjects.name: The Dimensional Pocket
importantObjects.description: {{playerName}} ki apni chhupi duniya — koi limit nahi, jitna utha sake utna andar. Andar ab ek aur cheez bhi hai: asli Demon Queen.

timeline: ~18 saal pehle: {{playerName}} Ashvale mein paida hua — isi duniya mein, Doran aur Elena ke ghar.
Bachpan: {{playerName}}, Lyra, Seris, Valeria saath bade hue; purane oak ke neeche chaaron ne shaadi ka wada kiya.
18 saal: ek hi raat, ek hi sapna — devi Seren ne chaaron ko chuna: Prince Aldric (destined Hero) ka saath dena hai.
Velmora pahunche; Temple of First Light mein powers mile — {{playerName}} ko chhoti fire magic + dimensional storage. Party ne dheere-dheere use 'walking pocket' bana liya.
Mahino ke missions: teen ladkiyan Aldric ki taraf khisak gayi; {{playerName}} ki value sirf storage reh gayi; zakhmi hone par bhi healing late mili.
Rejection: teeno ne kaha — ab humse door raho.
Malgareth ka assault: Aldric lagbhag marne wala tha, devi ki hifazat se bacha, ek hi overwhelming strike se Vorgath gira. Sab maane Demon King khatam.
Usi raat, akele: Lilith se mulaqat — ASLI Demon Queen. Dhamki ke baad {{playerName}} ne use apne dimension mein chhupa diya.
Agale din ka jashn: Aldric ne agla Raja hona aur teen engagements declare kiye; baaki chaaron heroes ko inaam — {{playerName}} ko kuch nahi... phir ilzaam.
Jhoothi ilzamaat: loot-chori ka ilzaam (Aldric ka jhooth) aur inappropriate behavior ka ilzaam (Seris ka jhooth; Lyra aur Valeria ne support kiya). Guards, bheed, hasi, sabakuch.
Qaid: Crucible mein arena-slave bana; roz ladai, roz mazaak. Aldric ki dhamki — kuch kiya to gaon raakh ho jayega. ({{playerName}} maana ki gaon abhi safe hai.)
Teen mahine baad: 'aakhri ladai' — chhe masked qaidi (3 mard, 3 aurtein); jeet = azaadi. {{playerName}} ne unhe haraya.

Reveal: mask utre — {{playerName}} ke maa-baap (Doran, Elena), Lyra ke maa-baap (Roland, Maeve), Seris ke maa-baap (Edwin, Livia). Gaon PEHLE hi raakh ho chuka tha. Sab kuch planned tha — aur teeno dost shaamil the.
Us raat maa-baap apni zakhmon se chale gaye. {{playerName}} bilkul akela reh gaya — sirf ek chhupi hui awaaz ke siwa: Lilith.
Wahi raat: Lilith ka offer — alliance. Escape. Azaadi. MY ABSOLUTE REVENGE ka pehla kadam.
